items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: that’s the way I wanted to play: Max, Art Blakey, Roy Haynes, like those guys.

ctx.x: You mention working with singers, but how much does this go back – this approach to the instrument – go back to the influence of Max?

To the beginning. To the beginning. When I first started to play drums, that’s who I wanted to play like: Max. That’s probably why I liked Buddy Mack Simpkins, because he was close to that. He was close to doing that. He was like that. Like I say, he was – of all of us, he was our mentor, let’s say, and that’s the way I wanted to play: Max, Art Blakey, Roy Haynes, like those guys.
